mapper.select: SELECT id, title, updated_at FROM projects ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id ASC
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE id = #{projectId})
SELECT id, logo FROM projects WHERE id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (id, title, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE projects SET title = #{title}, updated_at = MAX(updated_at + 1, #{updatedAt}) WHERE id = #{projectId}
UPDATE projects SET theme = #{themeId}, updated_at = MAX(updated_at + 1, #{updatedAt}) WHERE id = #{projectId} AND theme IS NOT #{themeId}
UPDATE projects SET logo = #{logo}, updated_at = MAX(updated_at + 1, #{updatedAt}) WHERE id = #{projectId} AND logo IS NOT #{logo}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM runs r JOIN sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND r.status IN ('pending', 'running', 'waiting', 'cancelling') ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM actions a JOIN sessions s ON s.id = a.session_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND a.type = 'commit' AND a.status IN ('pending', 'running', 'cancelling') )
mapper.update: UPDATE projects SET updated_at = MAX(updated_at + 1, #{updatedAt}) WHERE id = #{projectId}
